scope.note: This checkpoint-only semantic audit is separate from the frozen-baseline canonical delta audit.

failClosedCriteria: Use Unicode-normalized bounded token-sequence equality; never substring or prefix matching.
Standalone calendar/season text and generic startup/founder/launch/product words are search hints, not attribution anchors.

A generic-search row auto-verifies only when an exact company-name sequence is corroborated by an official mapped channel, exact official domain, full roster founder, or an accelerator-bound exact cohort designator.
For common/dictionary/collision-known names, cohort text alone is insufficient; require official channel/domain/founder or at least two rare roster descriptor tokens.
A native owner, founder, domain, or known accelerator entity that resolves to a different roster company is a hard rejection.
Explicit contradictory batch/company identity is needs_review unless independent exact owner/founder/domain evidence resolves entity identity; the roster, never title text, supplies batch.
Persist native channel ID/URL and attribution anchors, and require them at merge for generic_search_target rows; search rank/title alone never produces verified evidence.
